podcast.title: Co-founder of PXXR GANG
podcast.body: Steve Lean, along with John Biff, Khaled, and K.D.K.in, founded PXXR GANG in El Raval, Barcelona. His production skills with cheap computers and heavy Auto-Tune were central to the group's sound. "Y una vez allí, junto a Steve Lin, fundan la banda que lo cambiará todo, la pur gang."

srcs.episode: La salvaje historia del TRAP ESPAÑOL (2013-2026)

podcast.title: Early Producer for John Biff
podcast.body: At the age of 16, Steve Lean, a young man from Barcelona, began producing tracks for John Biff. This early collaboration was a precursor to their joint work in PXXR GANG. "uno de ellos era un chaval de 16 años de Barcelona que se hacía llamar a Steve Lin, que no empezó a producir temas para John Biff."

podcast.title: Production Style
podcast.body: Steve Lean was known for producing music on cheap computers with a significant use of Auto-Tune. This DIY approach and distinctive sound became a hallmark of the early Spanish trap scene. "hacían musicales de ordenadores baratos con mucha autotune."
